characterization: A separately preregistered harness-correction attempt addressing two known probe defects. Not a rerun of the same exact protocol.

established: Native Tesseract 5.3.0 loaded and executed both the integer-quantized control model and the pinned float tessdata_best treatment model.
No timeout, signal, ABI error, loader error, or unsupported-model error.
harnessDefects: Bare model directories omitted Tesseract's configs/tsv, so the requested TSV renderer did not engage and output fell back to plain text.
The synthetic final 9 glyph was read as H by both models.

corrections: Harness correction 1: each ephemeral tessdata mount carries the pinned runtime's own configs/tsv; a plain-text fallback is a failed output condition.
Harness correction 2: the positive sentinel is LABEL LENS 123, whose digits are unambiguous.

failureSemantics: An Attempt 3 failure would not erase the fact that Attempt 2 loaded and ran both models.
